$comment: Issue-routing registry for this product repository and the tool repositories it consumes. Added 2026-10-12 (the nen 0.20 repin): without this file nen refuses to guess a taxonomy -- `nen repo classify`, `nen warmup`, `nen direct resolve` and `nen schema check` all read role, kind and gate from here rather than inferring them from the workflow file. The product code is KC, the one CLAUDE.md and docs/BANKAI-OPERATIONS.md already use. `pinned` is the nen tag this consumer's nen/contract.json pins (dependency.pinned_ref), so `nen warmup --current` can check it instead of reporting the consumer unpinned.

consumers.role: Kro for Web -- the Next.js 15 App Router PWA (Scenario 5, react-uzf-v1), the kroapp.com landing page and the hub app; a schema CLIENT of Kro Cloud, never its owner (the Supabase schema belongs to zheref/KroApple)

maintained_tools.role: Canonical handbooks, constitution and shared agent conventions (CON-13) -- the canon Hatsu reviewers resolve (UZF-, SEC-, UX-, QA-, REL-, RC-); this repository mirrors its stack rules under .claude/rules/
